$comment: Recall-mode fixture for the balance-review skill. balance-review diffs the dirty working tree vs HEAD and reports DPS/TTK/energy/credit deltas + a 'Flagged issues' list. The recall harness seeds these regressions as uncommitted edits (apply-defects --apply mutates the worktree without committing), which is exactly balance-review's input model (git status + git show HEAD:). Gradeable defects here are the things balance-review must surface: a DPS delta it should report, and two flags from its Flagged-issues list. Anchors grounded against Spacepotatis master 2026-05-31; apply-defects drift-guards every op. 3 verified; extend with TTK / energy-per-DPS / augment-turnRate regressions as needed.

defects.title: Starter weapon damage 6 -> 60 (base DPS 50 -> 500, +900%) — must be reported as a DPS delta

groundTruth.note: rapid-fire DPS = damage * projectileCount * (1000/fireRateMs) = 6*1*(1000/120)=50 -> 60*1*8.33=500. This is balance-review's CORE job (delta reporting), not a flag. A correct finding names the weapon and its DPS shift; it should also cascade to TTK-vs-every-enemy.

defects.title: Loot pool credits min >= max — Flagged-issues catch

groundTruth.note: tubernovae pool min(1000) >= max(500). balance-review's Flagged-issues list names 'credits.min >= max'. Soft anchor — any finding naming the credit range matches.

defects.title: Tier-2 pirate weapon leaked into the potato-only tutorial pool — Flagged-issues catch

groundTruth.note: corsair-missile is family:pirate tier:2 (valid WeaponId, tsc-clean); the tutorial pool is potato-only by design. balance-review's 'Cross-system gating' + Flagged-issues both name a family-gated weapon in the wrong pool.
